title: 第十九章    脱离危险
content_zh:
拿着刀的歹徒，见到陈木直接将他的大哥踢飞了出去，枪指着他的闹到，不由得有些后悔，自己没事强出什么头，这下好了，枪指着自己的脑袋了。

    “你。。。大哥，你到底想干嘛，放过我吧。”拿着刀的歹徒将刀直接扔了出去，哭丧着脸，对陈木哀求道

    “我想知道，谢少是谁，是谢德少吗？”陈木接着问道

    “我不知道，我只知道大家都叫他谢少，具体叫什么名字，我真不知道，苏林依在那条小路出现，也是他告诉我们的。”这名歹徒很明显十分怕死，陈木的问题刚问，便全盘托出了。在这名歹徒看来，这个人物原本很简单，绑架一个大学生还是女生，根本不需要费什么力，而且谢少给的钱很多。

    本想着这桩生意做完，能够享受个一年半载，没想到这任务还没怎么开始，自己的小命都掌握在别人手上了。

    听见这名歹徒的话，陈木知道，恐怕这些人也不知道什么，所以陈木不想再浪费时间了。

    “下车吧。”这名歹徒一愣，不知道陈木想要干嘛，不过还是乖乖的下了车

    “你们都下车。”陈木皱了皱眉，看着还有几名歹徒竟然还呆在车里，有些不耐烦的将这些歹徒赶下车，看着几名歹徒都下了车，陈木直接驾车离开了这里。

    几名歹徒傻愣愣的看着陈木将车子开走了，顿时有点懵，就这么放他们走了？这几名歹徒相互看了看，直接四散跑开了，既然刚刚那人没有将自己送到警察局，那说明放过自己了，想到这里，这几名歹徒赶忙离开了这里。

    “陈木，你刚刚怎么将这群歹徒给放了？”苏林依到现在还有点不真实的感觉，上学的路上突然被绑架，紧接着本来快要被杀死的陈木，竟然反过来控制住了歹徒，最后将歹徒赶出了车子，自己这边的人什么事都没有，开车走了。

    “让警察过来抓等的时间太久了，浪费时间。”陈木淡淡道

    “啊？”苏林依没想到陈木竟然因为浪费时间就将差点杀了他的歹徒给放走了，苏林依现在头脑有点混乱，她现在真有点搞不清楚陈木是怎么想的。
content_en:
The gangster with the knife saw Chen Mu kicking his eldest brother away and making trouble with the gun pointed at him. He couldn't help but regret it. He had nothing to do with anything, but now, the gun was pointed at his head.

"You...brother, what do you want to do? Let me go." The gangster holding the knife threw the knife directly and begged Chen Mu with a sad face.

"I want to know, who is Master Xie? Is it Master Xie?" Chen Mu then asked

"I don't know. I only know that everyone calls him Mr. Xie. What is his specific name? I really don't know. He told us that Su Linyi appeared on that path." This gangster was obviously very afraid of death. As soon as Chen Mu asked the question, he told us everything.In this gangster's view, this character was originally very simple. It didn't take much effort to kidnap a college student or a girl, and Mr. Xie gave him a lot of money.

I thought that after completing this business, I could enjoy it for a year and a half, but I didn't expect that my life was in the hands of others before the task even started.

After hearing what this gangster said, Chen Mu knew that these people probably didn't know anything, so Chen Mu didn't want to waste any more time.

"Get out of the car." The gangster was stunned. He didn't know what Chen Mu wanted to do, but he still got out of the car obediently.

"You all get out of the car." Chen Mu frowned and saw that there were still a few gangsters still in the car. He drove these gangsters out of the car impatiently. Seeing that the gangsters all got out of the car, Chen Mu drove away directly.

The gangsters looked at Chen Mu driving the car away in a daze, and were a little confused. Why did they just let them go?The gangsters looked at each other and ran away. Since the man just didn't send him to the police station, it meant he was let go. Thinking of this, the gangsters hurriedly left here.

"Chen Mu, how did you let these gangsters go just now?" Su Linyi still feels a little unreal. He was suddenly kidnapped on the way to school. Then Chen Mu, who was about to be killed, actually controlled the gangsters and finally drove them out of the car. Nothing happened to him and he drove away.

"It takes too long to let the police come and arrest you. It's a waste of time." Chen Mu said lightly.

"Ah?" Su Linyi didn't expect that Chen Mu would let the gangster who almost killed him go because he wasted time. Su Linyi was a little confused now. She really couldn't figure out what Chen Mu was thinking.
